reviewBoundary: Fourth producer deep review of the complete dirty candidate after R3 remediation. Prior pass/fix conclusions are treated only as historical evidence, not inherited approval.

findings.problem: If MCP add succeeds but readback fails or points at the wrong binding, install returns blocked while leaving the newly registered server behind.
findings.fix: Post-add failures now remove the just-created client registration, read back proven absence, and report separately when rollback itself cannot be verified.
findings.verification: Distribution tests simulate mismatched and failed post-add readback and prove the fake registration is absent afterward.

findings.problem: Advertised closed MCP schemas are not fully enforced at runtime for bounded strings, scalar changes, limits, enums and argument object sizes.
findings.fix: Runtime validation now mirrors bounded strings, finite scalar maps, object sizes, operation enums, limits and exclusive scalar/typed branches; the advertised schema declares the same one-of contract.
findings.verification: MCP tests reject oversized, wrong-type, unknown-enum and orphan-branch arguments without changing Timeline bytes.

findings.problem: After Studio open verifies source.sha256, an active browser session can continue apply/undo/redo when the source media changes; revision/project status only follows Timeline SHA.
findings.fix: The opened source identity is now a latched session invariant. Drift emits an SSE conflict, appears in project readback and blocks apply, undo and redo with HTTP 409 until reopen.
findings.verification: Editor API regression mutates the source after successful editing, observes source_identity_changed and proves command/undo/redo leave Timeline SHA unchanged.

findings.problem: renderProject does not recompute activePictureId or source seek mapping after EDL reorder/split, so the approximate preview can show the old clip at the current output tick.
findings.fix: Every project render now re-runs output-to-source seek mapping, and initial open orders video binding and playhead state before rendering.
findings.verification: Chromium reordered EDL a,b to b,a at output tick zero and the media element moved from source time 0 to 1 second.

findings.problem: License/provenance risk states are compared without canonical trim/case normalization, and missing externalUpload is disclosed as false, allowing malformed index evidence to look safer than it is.
findings.fix: Index audit now requires trimmed bounded text and an explicit externalUpload boolean; replacement eligibility is server-derived from canonical license/provenance states plus valid evidence.
findings.verification: Negative tests reject missing disclosure and padded fields, and block uppercase UNKNOWN or mixed-case Unverified replacement attempts.

findings.problem: Clearing a numeric Inspector field converts the empty string to zero, which can write an unintended valid value instead of rejecting incomplete input.
findings.fix: Inspector numeric controls are required and submission validates non-empty finite valueAsNumber before constructing a command.
findings.verification: Chromium forced an empty numeric submit, received a field-specific error and preserved the exact Timeline SHA.

findings.problem: The server expires a long-lived SSE session, but the browser treats the terminal expiry like a transient conflict and EventSource can keep reconnecting to the invalid session.
findings.fix: The browser recognizes terminal session expiry, closes EventSource, clears the active handle and presents EXPIRED instead of reconnecting.
findings.verification: Static distribution regression asserts the terminal close path while server session-expiry behavior remains covered by editor tests.

limitations: Producer review cannot self-approve independent final review.
Real creator normal-speed acceptance remains an external condition.
No commit, push, remote CI or public deployment was performed in this review turn.
